title: Incompressible numerical observable and pressure errors

items.title: Smooth MINI observation interface
items.statement:
Assume the Axiom of Countable Choice. Let $d\in\{2,3\}$, let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be a nonempty bounded connected Lipschitz polygonal or polyhedral open set, let $T>0$ and $\nu>0$, and let $\mathcal T_h$ be a conforming shape-regular affine simplicial mesh of $D$. Let $0=t_0<t_1<\cdots<t_N=T$ be a finite time partition with $\tau_n=t_n-t_{n-1}>0$, and put $h=\max_{K\in\mathcal T_h}\operatorname{diam}(K)$ and $\tau_{\max}=\max_n\tau_n$.

Write $V=H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)$, $Q=L^2_0(D)=\{q\in L^2(D):\int_Dq=0\}$, and $V_\sigma=\{v\in V:\operatorname{div}v=0\}$. Let $S^1_h$ be the continuous piecewise-affine scalar space on $\mathcal T_h$. For each simplex $K$ with barycentric coordinates $\lambda_{K,0},\ldots,\lambda_{K,d}$, set $b_K=(d+1)^{d+1}\prod_{j=0}^d\lambda_{K,j}$ on $K$ and extend $b_K$ by zero outside $K$. The conforming MINI spaces are
$$V_h=[S^1_h\cap H^1_0(D)]^d\oplus\bigoplus_{K\in\mathcal T_h}b_K\mathbb R^d,\qquad Q_h=S^1_h\cap Q,$$
and their weak divergence kernel is $Z_h=\{v_h\in V_h:b(v_h,q_h)=0\text{ for every }q_h\in Q_h\}$. Let $P_{Z_h}$ denote the $L^2(D)^d$-orthogonal projection onto this finite-dimensional subspace.

For $v,w\in V$, set $\varepsilon(v)=(\nabla v+\nabla v^{\mathsf T})/2$, $a_\nu(v,w)=2\nu\int_D\varepsilon(v):\varepsilon(w)\,dx$, and $b(v,q)=-\int_Dq\,\operatorname{div}v\,dx$. For $a,v,w\in V$, use the real skew convective form
$$c(a;v,w)=\frac12\int_D\big((a\cdot\nabla)v\cdot w-(a\cdot\nabla)w\cdot v\big)\,dx.$$
Thus $c(a;v,w)=-c(a;w,v)$ and $c(a;v,v)=0$.

A smooth MINI interface consists of a forcing $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$, an exact no-slip velocity-pressure pair $(u,p)$, and a mixed backward Euler MINI solution $(u_h^n,p_h^n)_{n=0}^N$ with the following conditions. The exact pair has $u\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^2(D)^d\cap V_\sigma)$, $p\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^1(D)\cap Q)$, and satisfies
$$(\partial_tu(t),v)_{L^2}+a_\nu(u(t),v)+c(u(t);u(t),v)+b(v,p(t))=(f(t),v)_{L^2},\qquad b(u(t),q)=0$$
for every $v\in V$, $q\in Q$, and almost every $t\in(0,T)$. The continuous representatives of $u$ and $p$ are used at the time nodes, and $u_0=u(0)$. The discrete initial value is $u_h^0=P_{Z_h}u_0$. With $f_h^n=\tau_n^{-1}\int_{t_{n-1}}^{t_n}f(t)\,dt$, each $u_h^n\in V_h$ and $p_h^n\in Q_h$ satisfies
$$\left(\frac{u_h^n-u_h^{n-1}}{\tau_n},v_h\right)_{L^2}+a_\nu(u_h^n,v_h)+c(u_h^n;u_h^n,v_h)+b(v_h,p_h^n)=(f_h^n,v_h)_{L^2},\qquad b(u_h^n,q_h)=0$$
for every $v_h\in V_h$, $q_h\in Q_h$, and $1\le n\le N$.

For a family of bounded real-linear velocity sensors $\ell_n\in V^*$, define the endpoint-sampled exact and discrete observations by
$$\mathcal O(\ell;u)=\sum_{n=1}^N\tau_n\ell_n(u(t_n)),\qquad \mathcal O_h(\ell;u_h)=\sum_{n=1}^N\tau_n\ell_n(u_h^n).$$
Define the accumulated exact and discrete pressures by $P(t)=\int_0^tp(s)\,ds\in Q$ and $P_h^0=0$, $P_h^m=\sum_{n=1}^m\tau_np_h^n$. Let $\bar p_h(t)=p_h^n$ on $(t_{n-1},t_n]$. For $\xi\in Q$ and $\eta\in C_c^\infty(0,T)$, define the accumulated-pressure observation $(P(t_m)-P_h^m,\xi)_{L^2}$ and the time-tested pressure observation $\left(\int_0^T(p(t)-\bar p_h(t))\eta(t)\,dt,\xi\right)_{L^2}$. The latter is an integrated pressure functional; it is not a pointwise-in-time pressure value. This definition supplies inputs and observables only and asserts no error rate or solver-existence result.

items.title: Bounded velocity-observation error for the smooth MINI branch
items.statement:
Assume Countable Choice and a smooth MINI observation interface as specified by the interface definition on this page. In particular, let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$ be bounded, connected, Lipschitz and polygonal or polyhedral with $d\in\{2,3\}$; use a shape-regular conforming affine simplicial mesh, viscosity $
u>0$, $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$, the mass-projected initial value, and any actual mixed backward Euler MINI solution. Suppose the exact no-slip solution has $u\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^2(D)^d\cap V_\sigma)$ and $p\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^1(D)\cap L^2_0(D))$. Set

items.title: Accumulated pressure-observation error for the smooth MINI branch
items.statement:

No mesh/time relation is imposed. Impose the time-step restriction $	au_{\max}\Lambda\le	frac12$ of the smooth-branch pressure-primitive theorem. Let $C_P(D)$ satisfy $\|v\|_{L^2(D)}\le C_P(D)\|v\|_V$ for $v\in V$. With

u\sqrt T+C_c(M_E+\sqrt T M_u)]
u^{-1/2} igr)C_*+ eta^{-1}(2
u T+2C_cT).$$
For every $\xi\in Q$, every $\eta\in C_c^\infty(0,T)$, and every node $0\le m\le N$, the interface observations satisfy
$$\left| igl(P(t_m)-P_h^m,\xi igr)_{L^2}ight|\le KH\|\xi\|_Q.$$

$$\left|\left(\int_0^T(p(t)- ar p_h(t))\eta(t)\,dt,\xiight)_{L^2}ight|\le(K+1)H\|\eta'\|_{L^1(0,T)}\|\xi\|_Q.$$

items.title: Weak velocity limits do not supply the smooth pressure-observation estimate
items.statement:
Assume both Countable Choice and the Axiom of Choice. Let $D\subset\mathbb R^d$, $d\in\{2,3\}$, be a nonempty bounded connected Lipschitz polyhedral domain, let $0<T<\infty$, let $
u>0$, let $V=H^1_0(D;\mathbb R^d)$, $Q=L^2_0(D)$, $V_\sigma=\{v\in V:\operatorname{div}v=0\}$, and $H_\sigma=\overline{V_\sigma}^{\,L^2(D)^d}$. Define $\varepsilon(v)=(
abla v+
abla v^{\mathsf T})/2$, $a_
u(v,w)=2
u\int_D\varepsilon(v):\varepsilon(w)\,dx$, $b(v,q)=-\int_Dq\,\operatorname{div}v\,dx$, and $c(a;v,w)=	frac12\int_D((a\cdot
abla)v\cdot w-(a\cdot
abla)w\cdot v)\,dx$. On each matching shape-regular affine simplicial mesh, let $V_{h,j}$ be the MINI continuous piecewise-linear velocity space enriched by one interior bubble per simplex and let $Q_{h,j}$ be the continuous piecewise-linear pressure space with zero mean. Set $Z_j=\{v_{h,j}\in V_{h,j}:b(v_{h,j},q_{h,j})=0	ext{ for every }q_{h,j}\in Q_{h,j}\}$. Take $f\in L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and $u_0\in H_\sigma$. Use a mesh family with maximum cell diameters $h_j	o0$ and time partitions $0=t_0^j<\cdots<t_{N_j}^j=T$ whose maximum steps $	au_{\max,j}$ tend to zero, without a relation between these limits. On each mesh, initialize by the $L^2$ projection of $u_0$ onto $Z_j$ and choose any actual mixed backward Euler MINI solution; write $ ar u_j(t)=u_j^n$ on $(t_{n-1}^j,t_n^j]$. A subsequence satisfies $ ar u_j	o u$ strongly in $L^2(0,T;L^2(D)^d)$ and weakly in $L^2(0,T;V)$, where $u\in L^\infty(0,T;H_\sigma)\cap L^2(0,T;V_\sigma)$ is weakly continuous into $H_\sigma$, has $u(0)=u_0$, and obeys, for every fixed $v\in V_\sigma$ and $\eta\in C^1([0,T])$ vanishing near $T$,
$$-\int_0^T(u(t),v)_{L^2}\eta'(t)\,dt+\int_0^T igl(a_
u(u(t),v)+c(u(t);u(t),v) igr)\eta(t)\,dt=\int_0^T(f(t),v)_{L^2}\eta(t)\,dt+(u_0,v)_{L^2}\eta(0),$$
and, for almost every $t\in(0,T)$,
$$ rac12\|u(t)\|_{L^2}^2+
u\int_0^t\|
abla u(s)\|_{L^2}^2\,ds\le rac12\|u_0\|_{L^2}^2+\int_0^t(f(s),u(s))_{L^2}\,ds.$$
The subsequential-limit theorem does not assert pressure regularity or a pressure-observation error estimate. The accumulated-pressure observation proposition on this page additionally requires the strong no-slip regularity $u\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^2(D)^d\cap V_\sigma)$ and $p\in W^{1,\infty}(0,T;H^1(D)\cap Q)$. Thus the weak-limit theorem alone does not supply that pressure estimate. This scope remark does not assert that a pressure is absent or rule out a separately proved pressure-primitive result.
